## IDE

- Preview what the next commit contains for a file, from the Git panel (read-only diff against HEAD).
- Run `tsc` or `cargo check` automatically when files change, with problems shown in the editor and a Problems panel. You must turn it on for each workspace.
- Configure local hooks in Settings > IDE hooks: before a Git panel commit (a failing hook blocks it), after files change, and after an agent turn.

These run in the IDE itself; no model is involved. Not yet verified by hand in the desktop app.
